page_title: NAP 1-0 ACM | Napoli v AC Milan 06/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Alisson Santos (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+5' Luka Modric (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who smothers the ball.
90+5' Luka Modric (AC Milan) takes a short corner kick.
90+4' Luka Modric (AC Milan) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. AC Milan have a corner.
90+4' AC Milan work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+4' Looks like Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
90+4' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+3' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Rafael Leao (AC Milan).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
89' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) and Santiago Tomas Gimenez try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
86' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches over the crossbar.
85' Antonio Conte has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sam Beukema (Napoli) replacing Juan Jesus.
85' Substitution. Kevin De Bruyne makes way for Eljif Elmas (Napoli).
84' Luka Modric (AC Milan) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
84' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
83' Luka Modric (AC Milan) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
82' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Youssouf Fofana is replaced by Rafael Leao (AC Milan).
82' Substitution. Fikayo Tomori leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan).
81' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Matteo Politano (Napoli) for his blatant foul.
79' 1 - 0 Goal! Matteo Politano (Napoli) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
79' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Matteo Politano (Napoli) comes onto the pitch so that Leonardo Spinazzola can be given a rest.
74' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Christopher Nkunku will be replaced by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
73' Mike Maignan makes a brilliant save! Frank Anguissa (Napoli) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the top of the net.
72' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) took the corner.

72' Alisson Santos (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Napoli.
70' Giovane goes off the pitch and Alisson Santos (Napoli) comes on.
68' Koni De Winter (AC Milan) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
66' A rebound falls kindly for Zachary Athekame (AC Milan), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
66' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Luka Modric (AC Milan), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
65' The linesman raises his flag. Giovane (Napoli) is adjudged offside.
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) is replacing Niclas Fullkrug.
62' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Alexis Saelemaekers and he is replaced by Zachary Athekame (AC Milan).
59' Scott McTominay (Napoli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
58' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Frank Anguissa (Napoli), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles past the right post. Poor effort.
56' Flag up against Scott McTominay (Napoli). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
54' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
51' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

51' Giovane (Napoli) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Napoli.
50' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
47' A lofted cross from Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Scott McTominay (Napoli) sends a first-time strike goalwards, but he should have aimed better. His shot ends way wide of the right post.
43' Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
41' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to gather the ball.
37' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner way wide of the left post.
37' The referee blows his whistle, Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
37' Giovane (Napoli) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
35' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
34' The ball is cleared after Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
32' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from AC Milan.
27' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) sprays a pass out to Christopher Nkunku, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
26' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
23' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker.
22' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
20' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
18' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
13' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) launches himself at the ball from the free kick and produces a header which lacks accuracy, sending it just wide of the right post.
12' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Daniele Doveri didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
7' Giovane (Napoli) is flagged for offside.
6' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
6' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle after Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
5' Luka Modric (AC Milan) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
4' The game is interrupted. Frank Anguissa (Napoli) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Napoli will kick-off.
Daniele Doveri got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
